themedShowcase.title: 💡 Recommended Value Themes
themedShowcase.highRoeLowDebtDesc: Companies with latest ROE >= 15% and Debt-to-Equity <= 100%
themedShowcase.dividendGrowth5yrDesc: Companies with total annual dividend payouts that grew year-over-year for the last 5 consecutive years
themedShowcase.fcfPositive10yrDesc: Companies with positive free cash flow (FCF) for the last 10 consecutive years
themedShowcase.shareholderReturnHigh3yrDesc: Companies with latest 3-year average shareholder return ratio (Dividends + Buybacks / FCF) >= 70%
themedShowcase.roeConsistent7yrDesc: Companies that maintained ROE of 15% or higher for the last 7 consecutive years
themedShowcase.fcfMarginHighIndustryDesc: Companies with latest FCF margin (FCF / Revenue) >= 1.5x of their industry (SIC) median
themedShowcase.fcfMarginGrowth3yrDesc: Companies with FCF margins that improved year-over-year for the last 3 consecutive years
themedShowcase.earningsQualityHighDesc: Companies with latest 3-year average earnings quality ratio (FCF / Net Income) >= 0.9
themedShowcase.zeroDebtStrictDesc: Companies with latest Interest Expense = 0 and Long-term Debt = 0
